items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: this young lady that was vocalist with us, Kay Davis

ctx.x: Ah, yes, this young lady that was vocalist with us, Kay Davis, was a graduate of Northwestern University in the field of music, and her voice was very, very

beautiful, very, very piercing, very, very -- well, whatever. And this number that we recorded, she was part of an instrumental trio, and her voice pierced through everything so strong that we had to find some way to shade her voice down without destroying her delivery.
